observations: Caller context must be constrained for cacheable queries: use covered argument attributes rather than arbitrary caller traversal. Borrowed simplified values may belong to caller and need ownership checks before analysis as callee values.
Maintain per-query SimplifiedValues, dead blocks, known successors, SROA allocations and constant pointer offsets. Scope/lifetimes are separate from scoring.
Accumulate speculative SROA and load-elimination benefits, then reverse saved costs when escapes or conflicting uses invalidate the opportunity. Avoid retaining profitability facts past invalidation.
Threshold query may stop early; full estimates/features request complete analysis. Initial maximal bonuses permit early rejection only with a monotonic remaining-cost argument.
128-bit cost-benefit products combine per-block savings and entry/callsite frequencies; missing or zero counts disable the profile path, with fallback to unitless estimates.
Explicit profile policy distinguishes instrumented versus other profiles. User overrides target defaults only when explicitly present.
Cost-benefit decision has accept/reject/fallback bands; integer cross-products avoid division rounding. Tiny callee allowance and exclusion of never-executed code are heuristic policy.

Vector, single-block, call convention and hot/cold bonuses include documented arbitrary/default historical factors. Measure Ink target-specific alternatives instead of importing numeric magic constants.
Nested devirtualization analysis disables further indirect boosting to bound nested speculative cost. Calls charge arguments and target-specific penalties.
Feature extraction shares generic analysis but still duplicates some cost policy; source TODOs warn of heuristic contamination. Keep raw model features distinct from preset bonuses.
Inline assembly instruction counting intentionally excludes some outlined sections; cost models disclose unsupported/approximate regions rather than pretending exactness.
limits: Partial source observations only; no whole-file credit or local LLVM execution.
